full_prompt_en: A square, highly detailed oil painting shows a crowded group of older scholars gathered beside an ornate stone balcony above a distant city. The foreground is a pale stone ledge across the bottom, holding stacked books, two greenish round fruits, scattered small objects, and a gray bird standing near the left corner. The bird turns toward the people, its narrow beak and patterned wings carefully painted. Immediately behind the ledge, an older white-haired man in a rich deep-green robe bends forward and reaches his hand toward the bird or the objects before him. Full white sleeves and a gray beard brighten his form against the crowded darker bodies. To his left, another bearded man in an ocher-brown and red garment studies an open book in his hands. Behind them, several men lean close together; one appears to hold a small instrument or object, and another bends over a reddish cloth. Their pale faces and hands are interwoven with white collars, green fabric, burgundy folds, and golden trim. A large carved column rises at the center-left, its circular relief and dense gilt ornament catching small highlights. Beyond it, the left edge opens to a blue sky with pale clouds, flying birds, layered roofs, and a distant arcaded building above a finely painted city. The architectural opening gives the packed foreground a glimpse of much deeper space. At the far right, additional figures and cloth are partly cut by the frame. Daylight enters from the open left, lighting the pale stone, beards, faces, and pages, while the carved recesses and space behind the men remain warm and dark. Fine brushwork describes hair, feathers, textless page edges, sculpture, and fabric embroidery without making any inscription legible. The overall composition is lavish and bustling, balancing a near-overflowing human group against a narrow bright view of the city and an intricately ornamented stone setting.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、细节丰厚的油画呈现一群年长学者拥在华丽石阳台旁，俯瞰远处城市。前景一道浅色石栏横过底部，上面放着叠起的书、两枚发绿的圆果、散落的小物件，左角还站着一只灰鸟。鸟转向众人，细长鸟喙与带纹羽翼绘得很仔细。石栏后方，一名白发老人穿浓绿长袍前倾，伸手向前方的鸟或物件。宽阔白袖与灰胡须让他从拥挤的深色身体中显出。他左侧另一名蓄须男子穿赭褐与红色衣物，低头看手里打开的书。后方几名男子靠得很近；一人似乎拿着小工具或物件，另一人俯向红色布料。浅色脸和手与白领、绿衣、酒红衣褶及金色镶边交织。中央偏左一根巨大的雕花石柱升起，圆形浮雕与密集镀金装饰接住零星高光。越过石柱，左缘打开为蓝天、浅云、飞鸟、层叠屋顶，以及远方城市上方带拱廊的建筑。建筑开口让拥挤前景透出更深的空间。最右侧，更多人物与布料被画边部分裁掉。日光从开放的左侧进入，照亮浅石、胡须、面庞和书页，让雕刻凹处及人物背后的空间保持暖而深。细密笔触描写头发、羽毛、没有可读文字的书页边缘、雕塑与织物刺绣，没有任何铭文清晰可读。整体构图华丽而繁忙，以几乎溢出画面的众人平衡狭窄明亮的城市远景与繁复装饰的石质环境。
style_prompt_en: The oil-painted style is dense, ornate, and finely modeled, layering small warm highlights over deep green, burgundy, ocher, gray, and golden-brown masses. Intricate curling relief, textured cloth, pale folded planes, and feather-like marks are differentiated by precise local brushwork. A crowded foreground is balanced by one cooler, brighter opening that reveals long atmospheric depth. Directional daylight from that opening catches faces of forms, pale edges, and projecting details, while recesses remain rich and dark. Many small diagonals and overlapping shapes create a lively visual weave, yet a horizontal base stabilizes the composition. Edges are sharpest at illuminated focal details and softer within the warm shadowed crowd. The overall effect is theatrical and abundant, using material richness and compressed depth to sustain an animated painted surface.
style_prompt_zh: 油画风格密集、华丽、塑形细致，在深绿、酒红、赭色、灰色与金褐团块上叠加细小暖高光。繁复卷曲浮雕、有肌理的织物、浅色折叠色面及羽片般痕迹由精确局部笔触区分。拥挤前景由一处较冷、较亮的开口平衡，那里显出绵长的大气深度。来自开口的定向日光照亮形体的正面、浅色边缘和突出的细节，凹处保持丰厚深暗。许多细小对角线与重叠形态编成活跃视觉纹理，一道水平底部却稳住构图。受光焦点细节处边缘最清晰，暖阴影人群内部则更柔软。整体效果具有戏剧性而充沛，借材质丰厚度与压缩深度维持生动的绘画表面。
theme_en: A crowded gathering of scholars beside carved stonework and an open city view
theme_zh: 雕刻石柱和城市景观旁聚集的学者们
name: Joachim Wtewael
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
